architecture.text: Recent work optimizes long-context efficiency, agentic execution, and 3D-consistent world generation using hyperbolic geometry, gated linear attention, and hybrid sparse attention frameworks like HySparse2.

new-models.text: Recent releases feature frontier open-weights systems like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro alongside domain-specific breakthroughs in medical foundation embeddings, multi-modal video reasoning, and flow-based generative materials discovery.

inference-methods.text: Practitioners are scaling test-time compute through search policies, applying on-policy distillation to sub-3-bit models, disaggregating prefill-decode quantization, and utilizing KV selection and speculative decoding.

inference-engines.text: Recent inference and serving developments focus on optimization techniques like SARA, DHSched, and Hot-Cold memory tiering to improve latency and resource efficiency in agentic LLM and avatar systems.

silicon.text: Engineers are scaling AI hardware by optimizing TPUs like v6e, mitigating GPU cluster power surges, and refining DRAM, HBM, and optical interconnects.

training.text: Recent research targets RL alignment and reward hacking through techniques like PACT credit assignment, RULER rubric rewards, and group relative policy optimization for speech translation.

economics.text: Inference costs are collapsing industry-wide by forty to fifty percent, driving self-hosted open-weight unit economics toward token prices that are effectively too cheap to meter.
